venueTrends.venue: Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association Stadium, Dharamsala
notes: High-altitude venue (~1,457 m) — ball travels further than at sea-level grounds, which historically correlates with slightly higher boundary counts.
Generally batter-friendly surface when fresh; evening dew can assist chasing in night matches.
